nodes.label: Cedar is what the access policy compiles to
nodes.summary: The active policy rules of the graph compile to Cedar, the open policy language with a verified evaluator, and the bundle carries a JSON form of the same rules beside the Cedar text, so the engine's evaluator and the hooks stay plain Python over the standard library and never need a Cedar engine on the machine that runs them.
